observations: Photo 0-3: Same heavy-duty pedestal/standing fan, four near-identical close-up angles, no wide shot of full body or rear.
Round black wire safety cage, 3 wood-tone (brown) colored blades, brass/gold colored motor housing with a small red logo/text on center cap too small and blurred to read in any photo.
Black weighted round base with cut-out carry handles, no wheels visible.
No speed control switch, timer dial, or control box visible in any photo.
No power cord or plug visible in any photo.
No shot of the motor's rating/label plate (brand, wattage, voltage).
Fan is stationary in all photos; no video, no blades shown spinning, no sound/motion evidence.
Background shows a plain tiled room with a cardboard carton and what looks like a fridge/cabinet, consistent with a home/store setting, not a studio listing shot.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI BLESSING ODII' overlaid on all photos, seller-applied, not device-authenticating.

claims.evidence: No original packaging, receipt, or purchase date shown in any photo; cannot confirm age or origin from images.
All 4 photos show the fan static and unplugged; no video or photo evidence of it spinning, oscillating, or running at any speed.

risks.risk: Motor may not run or may run poorly (noise, weak airflow, no oscillation) despite 'working perfectly' claim
risks.proof: Short video clip of the fan plugged in, switched through all speeds, and oscillating
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needs motor check

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional speed/oscillation control switch (not visible in any photo)
risks.proof: Clear photo of the control box or switch base showing speed settings
risks.if_unproven: priced as basic/no confirmed multi-speed function

risks.risk: Unknown brand/wattage, which affects durability and part availability
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the motor rating plate or any brand sticker on housing or rear

risks.risk: Power cord/plug condition unknown (could be frayed, cut, or missing plug)
risks.proof: Photo of the full cord and plug
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming cord may need replacement

risks.risk: Blade material could be brittle plastic rather than durable material, affecting lifespan
risks.proof: Close-up photo of a single blade showing material texture/thickness
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard plastic blade, no premium

proof_requests: Video of the fan plugged in and running on all speed settings with oscillation
Close-up photo of the motor's rating/label plate and any brand marking
Photo of the full power cord and plug
Photo of the speed control switch/box
Photo of the fan from a distance showing full height and overall condition
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a heavy-duty pedestal fan, but 'brand new' and 'working perfectly' are unverifiable from static photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified/untested unit of unconfirmed brand.
